title: Cybersecurity Tools & Technologies Reference

technologies.name: Wireshark
technologies.purpose: Deep packet inspection, troubleshooting network latency, decrypting TLS (with session keys), and detecting anomalous traffic patterns.

technologies.name: Splunk Enterprise / Splunk Free
technologies.purpose: Aggregating millions of security logs across servers and endpoints, creating dashboards, and executing Splunk Processing Language (SPL) threat hunting queries.

technologies.name: Nmap (Network Mapper)
technologies.purpose: Host discovery, port scanning, OS detection, and NSE script vulnerability probing.

technologies.name: Suricata / Snort
technologies.purpose: Rule-based network threat detection and signature matching against known malicious exploits.
